transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… things have been off at work. My hands feel really slow, like I’m moving through glue or something. Even sectioning hair or mixing color takes me forever now, and people are starting to notice I’m not as quick as I used to be.
Are you experiencing this slowness just at work or in other parts of your life as well?
Mostly at work, I think. That’s where I notice it… my hands just don’t move right, like they’re stuck or something. Even simple stuff takes me too long, and people have started noticing.
Do you feel like your mind is slow or it's just your body that's moving slowly?
I think it’s more my body… my hands, mostly. Like at work they just move so slow, and things like sectioning hair or mixing color take way longer than they should. People have noticed.
Do you have any shaking or trembling in your hands?
Not really… I haven’t noticed shaking. It’s more like they’re just slow.
Do you experience any pain in your hands when they move slowly?
No… I don’t think it hurts. It’s just slow, like they don’t want to move right.
Are you having trouble with everyday activities at home because of your slow hands?
A little, yeah… mostly when I’m doing work-type stuff. My hands feel like they’re moving through glue, so even simple things take me longer than they used to.
Do you feel like your speech is slower than it used to be?
Maybe a little… I notice it more with my hands, like at work. Sectioning hair or mixing color takes forever now, and people have noticed I’m slower than I used to be.
Do you feel like it takes you longer to think through things or make decisions than it used to?
Yeah… sometimes. Like I’ll look at a color formula or the appointment screen and my mind just kind of… blanks. Then I start second-guessing stuff that used to be automatic.
Do you have trouble with your balance or coordination?
Not really… I haven’t noticed anything like that. Maybe I’m just slower, but I don’t think it’s balance or coordination.
Do you have trouble finding the right words when you're talking?
Sometimes, yeah. It’s more like… I’ll be looking at a color formula or the appointment screen and my brain just blanks. Then I end up second-guessing simple things I used to just know.
Have you noticed your symptoms getting worse over time?
Yeah… I guess so. It’s been going on for, I don’t know, about a year and eight months. It kind of started after my hours got cut and my savings started running out.
Do you feel like your memory has gotten worse over the past year and eight months?
Yeah… I think so. It’s more like my mind just blanks out. I’ll be staring at a color formula or the appointment screen, and then I start second-guessing things that used to be automatic.
Are you having trouble with relationships or daily activities outside of work because of your symptoms?

Yeah… some. I’ve kind of stopped seeing friends as much, and I quit showing up for the volunteer haircuts at the senior center.

At work, it’s affected things too. My manager and some clients don’t really trust me like before because I mess up basic routines, or I’m too slow, or I cancel things I used to handle. It’s… embarrassing.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?
Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s just this heavy, flat feeling, like… what’s the point of even trying to make things work the way I thought they would.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable?

Not really, no. I used to like talking with clients, helping the newer stylists, going hiking with my friends… stuff like that. Now I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. I don’t really have that spark in me anymore.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I don’t know the exact number… but yeah, I think so. I’ve been skipping meals without really noticing, and then at night I realize I’ve only had coffee and a few bites. My clothes are looser.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself lately?
I… not like I have a plan or anything. But yeah, sometimes I think it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up… like nobody would have to deal with me anymore.
Do you think your mind has gotten significantly worse over the past year and eight months?

Yeah… I think so. It’s like, at work I’ll stare at the color formulas or the appointment screen and my mind just… blanks. Then I start second-guessing really simple things I used to do without thinking.
Do you think your ability to think and remember has declined significantly over the past year and eight months?
Yeah… I think it has. I’ll look at color formulas or the appointment screen and my brain just kind of blanks. Then I end up second-guessing things I used to do automatically.
Do you think your memory loss and difficulty thinking are significantly impacting your daily life?

Yeah… it is. At work especially. My manager doesn’t really trust me like before, and some clients notice when I mess up basic stuff or take too long.

I’ve also been canceling things I used to handle fine… and I don’t really see friends much. I stopped going to do the volunteer haircuts at the senior center, too.
